newsitem.title: USA: Dollar General Jan same-store sales rise.
newsitem.headline: Dollar General Jan same-store sales rise.

text.p: Dollar General Corp said on Thursday same-store sales for the four-week retail reporting period rose 13.8 percent.

For the four-week fiscal reporting period for the company, which began January 4 in 1997 through January 31 and in 1996 was January 5 through January 31, same-store sales rose 25.7 percent. Total retail sales for the fiscal period were $131.5 million compared with $94.0 million last year, up 39.9 percent.
